scope: Local Chromium, actual app/SDK/IDB; synthetic Auth and generated samples. No actual Apple/IME/Google/production verification.
method: One initial seven-flow run and twelve-scene batch. After aligning selectors with the approved internal return UI and refreshing app state after direct IDB fixture seeding, only the affected three flows were rerun; a final mixed-flow-only check corrected the draft-row selector. The latest result for each acceptance criterion is reported below; no single final full-suite run is claimed.

checks.name: public import intent, explicit review, aborted write and retry
confirmed empty home exposes search and import without false resume
thirteen imported originals: recent six, global search, exact reader and link-only
mixed originals and saved writing share six recent rows; drafts and archive remain accessible
resume is conditional and preserves the exact older immutable BOM/CRLF version
read failures preserve known originals and retry before declaring an empty home
late reads cannot replace navigation, a new workspace, or the next account

initialFailureCauses: Hidden outer-header return selector after approved duplicate-header removal; actual inner return remained usable.
Direct IDB fixture writes were not followed by app reload, leaving the in-memory bundle/workspace list stale.
Drafts use .home-draft rows, while the initial selector expected .home-post.

preservation: Each read/browse/retry/scope scenario compares SHA-256 of actual stored originals, immutable versions and records; failed import abort leaves existing bundle unchanged. BOM/CRLF/emoji and older version text are checked exactly. New imports intentionally create a new original.
limitations: Linux Chromium viewport simulation, not actual Apple hardware, native IME, Google OAuth or production Supabase verification.
All fixtures are generated anonymous data; no private vault, real external content, production account or personal image is read.

requestedViewportCapture.method: Requested additional viewport-only capture of the same generated mixed fixture, after the visible thumbnail actual load; no added test flow.
